Re-profile and move it back to pending if the region crosses 0.5 s at another n or column count REVOKED 2026-11-12 (corrected the same day): its own condition is met, by less than first recorded. The wrapper wall of the fe_hinge_enable region inside a full fit is 14.7 s, but that figure includes waiting while stages run concurrently; the isolated call at n=100000, p=100 is 2.11 s (cProfile: 1.56 s in the host numpy QR of _hinge_slope_change_plausible over 100 columns), about 1.7% of a 120 s fit, still above the 0.5 s threshold (audits/2026-10-22/profiles/fe_family_walls_gpu_n100000_p100.md). The pending list cannot grow, so the entry stays here only until the device path exists; then the module moves straight to compliant.
